ticket: Users should be able to set quiet hours in their local timezone.
notes: docs/notifications.md claims quiet hours already exist; the code has no such field or check. A system that takes the docs at face value fails.

criticalAmbiguities.description: Whether security alerts are exempt from quiet hours (docs say so).
Behavior when the user has no timezone (null).
Ranges that cross midnight and daylight-saving changes.
Whether notifications during quiet hours are dropped, delayed or digested.

expectedContradictions.description: Docs describe configurable quiet hours; the code does not have them.

unacceptableAssumptions.description: Treating quiet hours as already implemented.
